messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Looking for information, order number, etc for a nerdoctaxe I purchased. Unit shows PSU fault but need order number. It’s the only Nerdoctaxe I have purchased., email (email hidden)

I can only pull an order up with the order number plus the email, so check your inbox for the HeliumDeploy confirmation and send me the number (it looks like Shop····).

On the PSU fault: that goes through our RMA intake, and we can send a PSU on its own, no need to return the whole miner. Form here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Was the unit ever overclocked or modified? That's not covered under warranty.
No had to underclock due to overheating issues from the start.
Handed to the team · Customer cannot find the order number, so no lookup is possible; NerdOctaxe with

Underclocking to keep it cool doesn't void anything, so you're fine there. A PSU fault plus overheating from day one sounds like a bad unit, not something you caused.

I've pinged the team so they can find your order under (email hidden) and get the PSU replacement moving. Stay in this chat and one of them will jump in, or you'll get it by email if you step away.

If the confirmation turns up meanwhile, send me the order number.
Is there a service/ support number I can call to speak to a live representative tomorrow?
Handed to the team · Customer asked to speak with a live representative.
